answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 52 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The mirror schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the pearl checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. A hostile operator wanting 161 effective identities must lock that capital for 52 epochs and keep it locked through every copper audit. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
